investigation: Local source inspection of gflow 0.72 first+last frame support
access: Read only source and existing saved capability snapshot; no gflow command, browser/profile call, generation, or runner edit.

sourceEvidence.finding: _run_i2v constructs GenerateVideoRequest with explicit resolved model, start_image and end_image from --end-frame. It does not switch to Veo when Omni is explicitly chosen.
GenerateVideoRequest supports optional end_image with the same Mode.I2V and VideoModel.OMNI_FLASH; no local orderable pricing key is selected here.
_attach_i2v_frames attaches the start to slot 0 and end to slot 1, including local files. The inspected DTO/attachment code has no prohibition on identical source content in both slots.

_assert_i2v_route requires batchAsyncGenerateVideoStartAndEndImage when an end frame is requested. It rejects a dropped end frame after submission, which may already have spent credits; it is not a pre-spend guarantee.
_submit_and_poll invokes that route check before returning successful video status. There is no inspected local equality check between the actual wire model key and the account offer key.
JSON video result echoes requested family model, mode, aspect, duration and count; it omits initial/end image identities, actual orderable model key, route and independent billable output count.

minimalRunnerProposal: Only after the active generation queue is safely settled, allow an optional --end-reference for video and freeze its original path/hash/role separately from the starting reference. Keep all prior start-only/image behavior.
When an end frame is present, request a fresh exact live quote for omni_flash_i2v_{duration}s_first_last; do not reuse the abra_i2v quote even when both costs happen to be equal.

Update form_media.reserve model-key validation to derive the first/last key from the explicit end-frame presence. Require the quote requirements to include TEXT, START_IMAGE and END_IMAGE, along with the intended duration, aspect and 720p support.

Pass the exact separately reviewed same bottom image as both start/end; freeze both roles and hashes. Make unique upload filenames for the two slots, verify each upload hash, and append --end-frame only to video i2v.

Record the requested end-frame role in durable attempt metadata and keep the exact fresh quote/snapshot. Preserve submitted-before-wait and uncertain reconciliation; gflow can fail after a paid submit if the route drops a frame.

Validate the result echoed model/mode/aspect/duration/count and the actual media dimensions/duration. gflow success additionally implies its StartAndEndImage route check passed, but does not prove the actual billed wire model key.
Reconcile actual account credit delta with the first/last quote as before. Do not auto-retry or create a new logical shot: the final Lat motion is the third and last allowed attempt.
recommendation: First/last support is present and the saved account capability evidence identifies the exact separate offer. A minimal provenance-preserving runner addition is feasible if the root obtains a fresh quote and accepts the existing limitation that actual wire model identity is not returned. Otherwise retain the reviewed single-bottom-start approach. In both cases, final paid submission remains gated on the exact new bottom reference.
unknowns: Whether this particular account retains both frame slots at submission has not been exercised in this investigation.
Identical initial/end frames may favor little motion; the prescribed full overhead release still requires review of the actual complete clip.
The saved 12-credit offer is evidence only, not a new live reservation or permission to bypass quoting.

supersedingHostEvidence.finding: Legacy first/last path and account offer exist, but installed migrated-host driver refuses end frames before generation. Do not submit end-frame requests on this active host.
